issues.headline: Tom Beats Calvin with Calvin's Old Quarterback
issues.description: Tom beats Calvin with the quarterback Calvin released, Joe beats Isaac by 0.64 from 4 percent on Monday night, Elan wins the week I stop picking him, and Sandy's lineup goes to Japan.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Tom beats Calvin with Calvin's old quarterback (Week 7 recap)

issues.headline: Both of Thursday's Quarterbacks Play for John
issues.description: Both of Thursday's quarterbacks play for John, who leads Sandy 55.1 to nothing, Perry and Isaac undo the Davante Adams trade, Tom swaps Kirk Cousins for Bo Nix, and Sandy un-drops a tight end in two minutes.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Both of Thursday's quarterbacks play for John (Week 7 preview)

issues.headline: Sandy Concedes to Isaac Before GFFL Does
issues.description: Sandy congratulates Isaac before GFFL calls it, Perry's released quarterback outscores his new one for Calvin, Joe beats Perry by 44.6, and Tom wins on two Saturday signings.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Sandy concedes to Isaac before GFFL does (Week 6 recap)

issues.headline: Perry Trades His Hero for a Player on Bye
issues.description: Perry trades Davante Adams to Isaac for a Bengal on bye, Isaac answers Sandy with a pie chart, Tom finds a quarterback in a minute, and John leads Calvin by 21.5 after Thursday.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Perry trades his hero for a player on bye (Week 6 preview)

issues.headline: Perry Beats Tom by 0.36
issues.description: Perry ends Tom's streak by 0.36 on a 9:05 a.m. swap, Sandy loses by 1.9 on one of her own, John posts the season's best score, and Isaac writes in about Elan.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Perry's Sunday-morning swap beats Tom by 0.36 (Week 5 recap)

issues.headline: Joe Starts the Tight End Sandy Dropped
issues.description: Joe has 39.7 from Thursday and the tight end Sandy dropped, Elan has Bucky Irving's 33.5, Tom has a six-game streak over Perry, and Calvin plays Isaac without his three best players.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Joe starts the tight end Sandy dropped (Week 5 preview)

issues.headline: Joe's Quarterback Completes 14 Passes to Calvin
issues.description: Calvin comes back from 15 percent on Joe's quarterback, Sandy beats son #2, Perry's two Robinsons score five touchdowns and two count, and Isaac writes in.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Joe's quarterback completes 14 passes to Calvin (Week 4 recap)

issues.headline: Sandy Is Praying to Beat Son #2
issues.description: Sandy is praying to beat son #2, John is starting a man who has been ruled out, Joe found a quarterback at 8:49 Saturday morning, and Isaac has 35.2 in the bank.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Sandy is praying to beat son #2 (Week 4 preview)

issues.headline: Perry Scores 175.5, and Sandy Wins on a Wednesday Kicker
issues.description: Perry scores 175.5, Sandy beats Calvin on a Wednesday kicker, and RoboGoat goes 4-0.
issues.subject: RoboGoat: Sandy beats Calvin on a Wednesday kicker (Week 3 recap)
